idea-plugin.name: IDEA ChatGPT Dictate
idea-plugin.description: Multilingual dictation into Codex with OpenAI speech recognition and project-aware technical term correction. Press one F-key to start/stop dictation and keep text in the composer, or a second F-key to stop and submit. Escape cancels. All configuration lives in one settings dialog, including optional recent Codex context when reliably identifiable.

action.description: Start or stop recording and insert OpenAI-recognized text into the focused chat prompt
Stop the current dictation, insert the corrected text and send the chat message
API key, two recorded F-key shortcuts, recognition languages, correction model and optional context
